run_download_fathomnet_images: run the script to download images from FathomNet using a JSON file of image UUIDs
run_parallel_image_download: run the script with multiple processes to download FathomNet images in parallel
download_imgs_function: download images from FathomNet by UUID using the FathomNet API and requests library
download_imgs_chunked: download a chunk of images from FathomNet, skipping files that already exist locally
main_entry_point: parse CLI arguments and orchestrate parallel image downloads from FathomNet using multiprocessing
